description_en: Creates a session analysis task. After the task is created, use the session ID with GetDialogAnalysisResult to retrieve the results
description_zh: 创建会话分析任务，创建成功后可根据会话ID使用GetDialogAnalysisResult查询结果
kebab_example: aliyun dianjin create-dialog-analysis-task --workspace-id llm-xxxxx --meta-data summaryConstraints=XXX sopInfo=XXX labels=XXX --play-code common --analysis-nodes DIALOG_LABEL --request-id 0FC6636E-380A-5369-AE01-D1C15BB9B254 --conversation-list '[[{"role":"1","content":"您好，我是2001，很高兴为您服务！"}]]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDialogAnalysisTask

parameters.help_en:
The metadata. This includes business-related properties that are used during session analysis. The business system passes these properties in real time when it initiates the analysis task.

```
{
  "labels": "XXX",  // Tags
  "summaryConstraints": "XXX",   // Summary dimensions
  "sopInfo": "XXX"  // SOP information
}
```
parameters.help_zh:
元数据，用于会话分析过程中需要消费的一些业务相关的属性，由业务系统在发起会话分析任务的时候实时传入。
```
{
  "labels": "XXX",  // 标签
  "summaryConstraints": "XXX",   // 摘要维度
  "sopInfo": "XXX"  // SOP信息
}
```
parameters.name: meta_data

parameters.help_en: The session scenario code, which is associated with the session analysis configuration
parameters.help_zh: 会话场景编码，关联会话分析配置
parameters.name: play_code

parameters.help_en: A list of analysis nodes. If you leave this parameter empty, all nodes are analyzed. You can specify one or more nodes
parameters.help_zh: 分析节点列表，默认为空，表示全部节点。可传入一个或者多个
parameters.name: analysis_nodes

element_fields.example: 您好，我是2001，很高兴为您服务！
element_fields.name: content

element_fields.help_zh: 角色（0: 客户；1: 坐席）
element_fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: The session content. You can specify multiple sessions
parameters.help_zh: 会话内容，可传入多个会话
parameters.name: conversation_list
